newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent turns lower with heat, briefly cracks $2.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent turns lower with heat, briefly cracks $2.

text.p: IPE Brent crude futures briefly dropped to fresh session lows under $23 a barrel on further profit taking and a weaker open in NYMEX heating oil, traders said.

"We've had a good run up so we're getting a setback," said one trader who viewed this week's earlier gains as a positive sign. "We're just seeing some minor profit taking...Technically everything is still looking pretty solid."
At 1524 GMT, March Brent was off 16 cents at $23.02 a barrel after hitting a new session low of $22.96 a barrel. It failed to top its session high from Thursday at $23.25, reaching $23.21.
So far it has posted a so-called "inside trading day", normally a sign of consolidation, by staying within yesterday's session range that had a low of $22.75.
Feb gas oil lost $3 to $209 a tonne and flirted with a downside gap established at mid-week at $205.50 to $204.50.

On the weather front, which has dictated prices in much of the last month, private forecast Weather Services Corp sees temperatures near normal to slightly above normal for Friday and Saturday and then slightly below normal through Tuesday in the Northeast U.S.
No major cold was expected for Northwest Europe.
